notes.summary: Manuscript page 66 defines cosupports of a family in the figure family and in M, then gives a braced relationship between them, with marginal notes on mutual determination and closed parts. It defines a second cosupport, naming it support, and asserts inclusion of the original family and stability under Sup and passage to a subfigure. A union of barred H_i is introduced, followed by equalities intended to reduce the construction to M. The bottom defines saturated parts: the first definition says cosupport of its cosupport; the second literally says cosupport of its support. It ends with two corresponding set equations, the last using barred F. These are the manuscript’s assertions, not mathematical results validated in this run.
math_reading_decisions: Membership was expected after the first H_i, but its upright and single rightward bar support the literal vdash sign. The second top relation is a curved membership sign; the occurrences are not normalized.

The repeated definitions prompted inspection of the single/double p spellings. Top operators and the M double-prime definition have cosup; the cancelled repeated family definition and live family double-prime definition have cosupp. The spellings remain local.

The expected parallel form in the two saturated definitions prompted inspection of the second noun. Its ink begins directly with s, with no co prefix: son support is retained. The notes do not repair or prove that statement.
The final set-builder has a distinct bar over F; H omits that bar. The bar is consequential and is retained.

The lower two-stem sign before Y is angular and can be forall or compressed tt; the graphic form favours forall, while the doubt remains. The two detached points beside the altered M subscript are kept at their low written level without assigning a meaning.
author_checks: Visible revisions include the cancelled Donc draft with its repeated equation, the cancelled contient Phi, altered operator subscripts, overwritten M-like forms, and raised inclusion, continuation, F_0 and M_0 additions.
No explicit à vérifier or sauf erreur is legible on this page. The terminal narrow two-loop mark after dans M. is a section sign, not a question mark.
The first braced equation and the two final equations are transcribed as stated; no proof of their equivalence or the saturation assertions was attempted.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Manuscript page 66 at the top centre; archive scan 67. Partie saturée introduces the lower definitions. No date or separate page-count statement is present.
